svg.title: ByT5 encoder classifier
svg.desc: Each of the four poem lines is normalized and encoded as UTF-8 bytes, with each byte value shifted by 3 and an end token (ID 1) appended. The pretrained google/byt5-small encoder, fully fine-tuned, embeds the 384 byte tokens into 1,472 dimensions and applies 12 transformer layers, each with RMSNorm, self-attention with 6 heads of width 64 and relative position bias, and a gated-GELU feed-forward block of width 3,584, followed by a final RMSNorm. Masked mean pooling gives one 1,472-dimensional vector per line. Dropout and a linear layer give four logits per line, a temperature-scaled softmax gives line probabilities, and their mean gives the poem prediction. 217,663,364 parameters in total.
svg.text: A pretrained byte-level encoder scores each of the four lines; the poem label is the mean of the line distributions.
each line processed independently · shared weights
Unicode NFC · ID = byte + 3 · end token appended
google/byt5-small · revision 68377bd · encoder only, decoder discarded
Average over real tokens; padding positions excluded
T fitted on a held-out calibration split after checkpoint selection
L = byte tokens per line · step 06 values are illustrative
